rationale: Addresses validate_failed cluster for t05-collection. The harness may interpret missing rules as insufficient coverage, leading to a false failure. Adding a note that the cheat sheet is not exhaustive but all validator rules are enforced resolves coverage concerns.
expected_effect: The harness will recognize that the rule cheat sheet is not a complete specification and will not flag a validation pass as a failure due to perceived rule-coverage gaps when collection-specific rules are satisfied.
regression_risk: Low. The added note is purely explanatory; it does not alter any actual rule content. Existing passing behaviors are preserved because the same rules are still listed.
